map.刺客爆發／側翼切入：靠技能連段在短時間內收掉關鍵目標，進場與退場路線要事先想好。: Assassin burst / flanking: delete key targets with a quick combo, and plan your entry and exit route.

map.3 條路線＋野區，地圖目標決定勝負節奏。: Three lanes plus jungle; objectives set the tempo.
